Calculation governance

Settings & Rules

Authoritative logic used by this version.

Short Steaming

Manual vessel-level Yes/No only. No field, including GEN_CARRIER, can classify Short Steaming automatically.

SS vessels remain available for diagnostics but are excluded from combined NVV KPI numerator and denominator.

NVV

NVV applies to discharge FCL. MTY and restow are excluded. Import requires local POD + Import category + GEN_TRUCK. HLC ITT may use GEN/Truck routing with Transship category and local POD. Normal transshipment requires non-local POD + Transship + specific next-vessel visit.

Rehandles

WI potential rehandles are evaluated within the same POW using current stack/tier plus planned move time, queue and sequence. Different-POW stack interactions are shown separately as cross-POW demand.

Yard

Yard Inventory is independent. Without a capacity denominator this tool reports population, not Yard Occupancy %. FCL without Outbound Visit is a yard data-completeness indicator, not the WI NVV KPI.
